intro.headline: Design, measured
intro.lead: Nine years designing products people actually use, across fintech, e-commerce, real estate and government. I own the whole arc, AI-native now: research, design, hand-off, and the number it moved after launch.
intro.note: Working across Egypt and the Gulf.

clients.label: Worked with

clients.title: Teams across Egypt, the Gulf and beyond

statement.quote: The first deliverable was not a design. It was a written evaluation.

ai.label: AI
ai.title: Designing AI products, and building with AI
ai.note: Discovery at work is AI-native: I frame a problem against comparable systems in minutes, produce wireframes live in the same session with the PM, then run an agent that audits the designs against the requirement before hand-off. The things below are what came out of working that way.

items.name: This site
items.line: Designed and built solo with AI, from the design system to the code: content model, editor, image pipeline, and deploy. You are looking at it.

items.name: Design-System Generator
items.line: Generates a complete design system from brand input: tokens, components, themes. A canvas turns a written business request into on-brand screens, and exports in one click to Figma and to code on GitHub. In use by my team at b_labs.

items.name: Agarly
items.line: A rental marketplace, designed and shipped solo using AI across the whole stack: front end, back end, database, hosting, admin panel, and a CRM with customer analytics. Live and running.

items.name: Iconoro
items.line: An AI-generated 3D illustration library. Ten thousand consistent, searchable illustrations per pack, held to one visual language across the set. Launching soon.

roles.title: Senior Product Designer, Marketplace & Pricing

roles.title: Senior Product Designer
